'''Chris Schoenthal''' is listed as '''Tournament Advocate''' on public Players Committee organization charts, with forum handle '''imrahil327''' and role contact tournaments@starwarsccg.org. That handle matches the Tournament Advocate entry on the ~October 2014 starwarsccg.org About "Current Advocates" block (handle only there).<ref name="swcabout2014">[https://web.archive.org/web/20141009180158/http://www.starwarsccg.org/about/ About], starwarsccg.org (Wayback, 9 October 2014)</ref><ref name="orgchart2021">PC Organization Chart PDF, CreationDate 8 July 2021; [https://web.archive.org/web/20211005193353/https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf Wayback 5 October 2021]</ref><ref name="orgchart2024">PC Organization Chart PDF, CreationDate 6 May 2024; [https://res.starwarsccg.org/orgchart/orgchart.pdf live orgchart.pdf]</ref>

== Documented PC roles ==

* '''~October 2014:''' Handle '''imrahil327''' listed as Tournament Advocate (legal name not printed on that About capture).<ref name="swcabout2014" />
* '''Org chart 2021:''' Tournament Advocate; handle '''imrahil327'''; legal name Chris Schoenthal.<ref name="orgchart2021" />
* '''Org chart 2024:''' Tournament Advocate; handle '''imrahil327''' (continuous vs 2021 Advocate row).<ref name="orgchart2024" />
